ValidationRule.description: Cannot change Status if set to Rejected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_uAssist_Status_Validation),
ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "Rejected") && ( ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "In Progress") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Model Prep Complete") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Model Prep in Progress") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Tech Review") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Modification Complete") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Modification in Progress") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Modification Requested") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Treatment Plan Review") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - Rx Form needs review") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - New photos needed") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - New scans needed") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - New X-Rays needed") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - New scans, photographs and X-Rays needed") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - Scans and images do not match") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - Please review uAssist Message") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "On Hold - New photos and Rx form review needed") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Case ready to review") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Cancel") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Completed") ) && CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "uAssist User") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change Status if set to Rejected
